observations: body L7: the hamza of «جزءًا» is cast with its fatḥatān in one sort (4.6 by 5.2 points), as the hamza with a damma or a dammatān on pp. 329-331.
body L9, L10, L11, L30: «تاريخ» (L9), «كنند» (L10, L11) and «الميزان» (L30) are printed with elongated joins (kashīda), not transcribed.

body L10, L11, L12, L13: in the Persian passage the final yāʾ is printed without dots («رومى», «فارسى», «عربى») and is transcribed ى; the medial yāʾ has its dots. «ا لد لح ك» (L10), «ا له لح مد» (L11) and «{0} ا {0}» with «كد» (L12-L13) are abjad numerals, 1° 34′ 38″ 20‴, 1° 35′ 38″ 44‴ and 0° 1′ 0″ 24‴ of the Latin rendering; the zero is the sign of the tables, as on p. 328.
body L24: the semicolon after «منزلةً» is printed with the tail of its comma detached (two dots and a tail), not as a colon.
body L8, L22, L24, L25: «مرتبة» (L25) is printed without the fatḥatān that «مرتبةً» has in L8, L22 and L24.
body L27, L28: the kasra under the alif of «اِنْحَطَّ» (L27) stands low, just above the mīm of «منحطّ» (L28), which has only the shadda.
body L29: the gāf of the Persian «ڭيرند» is printed as kāf with three dots above (ڭ) and is transcribed so.
body L33: «مَرَاقُّ» has a damma over the shadda of the qāf, as «الدُّبّ» has over its dāl.
body L36, L38: the last digit of «١٧٢» is 3.0-3.1 points wide (L36, L38) and that of «١٧٣» 4.7 points (L36); the ٤ of «١٧٤» (L38) is 3.6 points.
body L39, L40: «ken-» is printed in bold italic (stems 1.3-2.0 points), «dra» in the ordinary italic of the page (1.1-1.3 points).
body L40: «الحاصّة» is printed without the dot of khāʾ, as on pp. 328 and 330; transcribed as printed.

transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
